scope: Four lab-held-out LibriSpeech test speakers; 16 synthetic stationary scenes, 96 method/scenario rows. Not clinical validation or a SOTA ranking. No guarantees of speaker disjointness from every third-party model training source.

config.rir_generator: 0.3.0 image method; RT60 is requested, not measured
config.fitting: Exact Clarity NAL-R FIR order 220, 110-sample delay removed offline; equal fitting and ±0.89 digital ceiling for all methods
config.metric_reference: Reverberant target-only ear image at microphones 0 and 2; not dry speech
config.neural_beamformer: Offline pretrained MetricGAN+ mask proxy + Souden MVDR, whole-utterance statistics
config.cue_metrics: Mixture-output vs target-image ILD 300–4000 Hz and integer GCC-PHAT ITD 300–1500 Hz (62.5 us resolution); not human localization error

speakers.selection: First four distinct speakers in archive order with >=3 s, excluding original demo speaker 6930; first 3 s used; no tuning

scoring_execution.rss_scope: Maximum individual scoring-worker RSS; not sum of concurrent workers
